need: Make the Structured Scanner operational surface appropriate for a non-technical registration Officer rather than exposing a harsh developer-oriented control.
candidates: Keep current minimal/raw control; EDIS-inspired polished Officer component with admin/runtime UX separation.
probe_or_evidence: Owner explicit decision after observing the real GF Scanner UI. Current scanner CSS is minimal and current field surface exposes a large raw capture box and English/technical cues; prior EDIS UX decision provides panel/card/spacing/status/RTL design language.
observed_result: Current runtime UI is functionally rendered but visually sparse and technical. This is an observed UX gap, not a data-architecture defect.
decision: Close Officer-facing UX requirement: simple, clean, visually polished Persian RTL component; compact transient capture; clear not-saved meaning; semantic ready/processing/success/error states; obvious activation/retry; technical profile keys, field IDs and mapping details remain admin/Form Builder concerns. Reuse EDIS-inspired visual patterns without importing its backend architecture.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if an actual Gravity Forms/Flow/Nested rendering constraint prevents the selected presentation without breaking native behavior; such a failure reopens only the presentation implementation, not Scanner persistence/data contracts.

need: Stop low-value Environment Inventory bureaucracy and continue implementation progression.
candidates: Continue collecting residual inventory vs proceed to Semantic Field Contract with partial environment evidence
probe_or_evidence: Owner explicit instruction in chat + real WordPress Site Health inventory already supplied + Master v1.8.1 §31/§26 and Playbook v1.2.2 Stage 0 sequencing.
observed_result: Core runtime stack is materially observed from the real site. Residual staging/license/cache/build-identity/GravityView details remain incomplete but are not required to decide the next semantic business bindings.
decision: Proceed to STAGE_0_SEMANTIC_FIELD_CONTRACT. Treat Environment Inventory as PARTIAL/OWNER_ACCEPTED_FOR_PROGRESS, not PASS. Preserve hard requirements: semantic bindings 1-3 before authoritative scaffold; privacy/retention before any real PII.
reopen_condition: Reopen residual environment inventory only if a later compatibility, deployment, license/entitlement, cache/CDN, or build-identity issue becomes decision-critical.

need: Bind the canonical money unit for SRWF finance fields.
decision: Use Rial as the canonical storage/display unit for tuition_amount, discount_amount and net_payable_amount.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if Owner changes the financial unit contract or a mandatory downstream interface requires a different canonical unit.

need: Close invalid-discount behavior so net payable cannot become negative.
candidates: Block save with validation error; auto-clamp net payable to zero
probe_or_evidence: Owner explicit decision in chat + current finance contract requires net_payable_amount = tuition_amount - discount_amount.
observed_result: Owner selected validation failure when discount_amount exceeds tuition_amount.
decision: If discount_amount > tuition_amount, show validation error and do not save. Combined with the prior Rial decision, Finance Semantics is Owner-approved for scaffold binding.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if Owner changes finance policy or a direct platform limitation prevents enforcing the validation without changing the canonical formula.

need: Close cheque output persistence for current release.
candidates: Scanner now vs hidden future fields
observed_result: Scanner input deferred; all seven Sayad output fields retained hidden.
decision: Keep hidden qr_version, owner_type, owner_identifier, iban, bank_branch, cheque_serial, sayad_id; no scanner population in current release.
reopen_condition: Reopen when scanner-based cheque entry returns to scope.

need: Define Officer correction of code-backed registration choices without exposing raw technical codes.
candidates: Edit visible human-readable choice and system-updated canonical code/value; raw-code direct edit
probe_or_evidence: Owner explicit decision in chat + prior native broad-correction decision + Master v1.8.1 Officer whitelist/code-backed field contract.
observed_result: Owner clarified that codes are stored in the background while users see real names, and the Registration Officer must be able to edit those names.
decision: Officer edits visible school/group/status names or choices through native controls; system updates the matching canonical stored code/value. Raw technical codes are not directly exposed/editable. This Owner decision supersedes the prior school_code Admin-only lock only for system-mediated updates caused by an Officer-visible selection.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if Owner changes correction policy or runtime evidence shows the native label-to-code update cannot preserve canonical consistency.

need: Close the remaining pre-scaffold finance/cheque requiredness and visibility contract.
candidates: Prior selective required fields vs all financial fields optional; public visibility vs Registration Officer-only surface
probe_or_evidence: Owner explicit decision in chat + Master v1.8.1 §31 requires finance required/defaults, cheque manual requiredness and Officer visibility/editability before scaffold.
observed_result: Owner stated that all financial fields are visible only to the Registration Officer and none are currently required.
decision: For current release, financial/manual-cheque fields are optional and non-public; expose them only on the Registration Officer operational surface as applicable. This supersedes prior tuition_amount required and conditional discount_title requiredness. Existing hidden future Sayad fields remain hidden; scanner remains deferred.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if Owner changes policy or the Accountant Approval surface proves it requires direct finance-field read access; any such reopen is visibility-scoped, not architecture-wide.
